## Root cause
`drag.start` (`src/drag.ts`) called `drawClear(s)` when the click target was an empty square or a piece of the non-turn color, *regardless* of the `eraseOnMovablePieceClick` option — that option only gated the own-movable-piece case. So there was no way to disable erase-on-click, exactly as reported.

## Fix
Made the option a real toggle that gates `drawClear` for **every** click, and renamed it to `eraseOnClick` (the API name from the issue):

```ts
if (!previouslySelected && s.drawable.enabled && s.drawable.eraseOnClick) drawClear(s);
```

- `src/drag.ts` — condition simplified; `drawClear` now only runs when `eraseOnClick` is true.
- `src/config.ts` — option renamed `eraseOnMovablePieceClick` → `eraseOnClick`; comment updated ("true to clear the drawing when clicking the board, false to keep it").
- `src/draw.ts` — `Drawable.eraseOnClick: boolean`.
- `src/state.ts` — default `eraseOnClick: true` (preserves current default behavior).

Default `true` keeps existing behavior; `false` fully disables erase-on-click (per-shape redraw-toggle still works).
